name: Process Stage
description: A sign-off gate within a process — the unit an operator submits and a verifier approves. The parent's `stage_label` decides what operators call these (set it to 'Module' and every screen reads Module). Steps are grouped onto screens by their `section`, so a 17-step stage still renders as five right-sized screens without a fourth level of nesting.

fields.label: Stage Code
fields.description: Stable identifier referenced by steps and run history. Never reuse a retired code.

fields.label: Sign-off Role
fields.description: Blank means operator self-inspection — whoever ran the stage signs it.

fields.label: Requires Second Sign-off
fields.description: Adds an independent verification step after the operator submits.

fields.label: Block Next Stage on Critical Fail
Screen Grouping
fields.options:
By Section
Fixed Count
One Per Screen
Single Screen
fields.description: By Section is the researched default — it matches how an operator physically moves around the subject.

fields.label: Stage Instructions
fields.description: Shown once before the first screen of the stage — safety notes, tools required.
